name: UE4SS Lua Event Bridge
description: Expose Unreal Enhanced Input events to UE4SS Lua mods through a native C++ bridge. Bind Lua callbacks to input actions and use engine-managed triggers, including Tap and Hold.

settings.Label: Enable load-time verifications
settings.Description: Runs the bridge's in-game checks when the game loads and writes PASS and FAIL lines to UE4SS.log. Takes effect on the next launch.

settings.Label: Enable function hooks
settings.Description: Lets Lua mods hook game functions through the bridge (Hooks.Install and Hooks.Request). Nothing is patched until a mod asks for a hook; off refuses every hook. Takes effect the next time Lua mods start.
